elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.5 makes Termination Assistance available following “the expiration or any termination” of the Agreement.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section 11.5 guarantees only at least 90 days after expiry or termination. Section 11.4’s six-month continued-services period is conditioned on a request at least 100 days before expiry and does not apply to every termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 states that all Expenses and charges for Termination Assistance are computed according to M&I’s then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.5 requires M&I to export and deliver all Customer Data in its possession within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not specify a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no deletion or deletion-certification obligation.

elements.evidence: Section 11.5 expressly applies following expiration or any termination.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
